# StackAdapt Academy

> StackAdapt Academy is a comprehensive learning platform offering certification courses, masterclasses, and training resources for programmatic advertising and digital marketing.

The academy provides structured learning paths covering platform fundamentals, advanced programmatic strategies, and specialized channels like DOOH, Native, Display, Video, Connected TV, and Audio. Content ranges from full certification courses to micro-learning videos and live webinars designed for marketers at all skill levels.

## Key Topics

- Programmatic Advertising
- Platform Certification
- Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH)
- Certification Courses
- Platform Education
- Ad Formats
- Audience Targeting
- Connected TV
- Native Advertising
- Display Advertising
- Video Advertising
- Audio Advertising
- Learning Paths
- Marketing Orchestration
- Advertising Strategy

## Certification & Learning Paths

- [Programmatic Masterclass](https://academy.stackadapt.com/path/programmatic-masterclass): Advanced programmatic advertising certification and expert training
- [Platform Certification Course](https://academy.stackadapt.com/path/platform-certification-course): Essential StackAdapt platform training for power users
- [Digital Out-of-Home Certification Course](https://academy.stackadapt.com/dooh-channel-certification): Free DOOH certification course covering digital out-of-home advertising

## Platform Training & Education

- [Platform Education](https://academy.stackadapt.com/page/platform-education): Platform certification course and walkthrough videos for StackAdapt
- [Platform Walkthroughs](https://academy.stackadapt.com/page/platform-walkthroughs): Guided training videos for StackAdapt platform features and tools
- [Micro-Learning](https://academy.stackadapt.com/page/micro-learning): Short-form video tutorials and platform walkthroughs for quick learning

## Programmatic Advertising Courses

- [Programmatic Education](https://academy.stackadapt.com/page/programmatic-education): Programmatic advertising courses covering multiple channels and formats
- [Developing a Business Case for Programmatic Advertising](https://academy.stackadapt.com/developing-a-business-case-for-programmatic-advertising-global): Article on building ROI justification for programmatic advertising

## Learning Resources & Events

- [Learning Webinars](https://academy.stackadapt.com/page/learning-webinars): Live webinars on marketing education, platform features, and strategies
- [Resource Library](https://academy.stackadapt.com/page/resource-library): Regional guides and documentation on ad formats and targeting
- [How to Cultivate Thriving Cannabis Marketing Campaigns](https://academy.stackadapt.com/s2-e7-how-to-cultivate-thriving-cannabis-marketing-campaigns): Webinar episode on cannabis industry marketing campaign strategies

## Reference & Tools

- [Reporting in StackAdapt](https://academy.stackadapt.com/reporting-in-stackadapt-global): Guide to StackAdapt reporting and analytics features
- [Quick Start Reference Guide (Analyze)](https://academy.stackadapt.com/stackadapt-quick-start-reference-guide-analyze-1): Quick start guide for StackAdapt Analyze tool
- [StackAdapt Pharma Campaign Checklist](https://academy.stackadapt.com/stackadapt-pharma-campaign-checklist-1): Campaign checklist for pharmaceutical advertising compliance
- [Frequency Capping](https://academy.stackadapt.com/frequency-capping): Definition and explanation of frequency capping in ad delivery
